name: Float Payment Gateway
author: floattechnologies

sections.description:
The Float plugin for WooCommerce lets your shoppers split any credit card purchase into interest-free* monthly instalments – using the credit card they already have.

No interest. No fees.* No sign up. No new credit.

Sign up at www.choosefloat.com today to get started.

Why choose Float?

By offering Float as a payment method to your shoppers, merchants can expect the following benefits:

  • Orders through Float are, on average, 134%* bigger than regular orders
  • Lift conversion rates by 20–30%*
  • 10× larger orders than checkout financing options
  • Works instantly with 60+ million Visa and Mastercard credit cards, globally
sections.faq:
I want to use Float for my business. How do I get started?

We’re delighted that you’re interested in partnering with Float to grow your business! Please complete our merchant enquiry form below.
UK: Merchant Enquiry Form: https://choosefloat.com/uk/merchant-sign-up/
Alternatively, reach out to grow@choosefloat.com and we will be in contact with you shortly.

SA: Merchant Enquiry Form: https://www.float.co.za/merchant-sign-up/
Alternatively, reach out to grow@float.co.za and we will be in contact with you shortly.

How does Float work for merchants?

Float is a card-linked instalment platform for your shoppers. It can be offered via ecommerce checkout, in-store, on an invoice, or even over email/text message.

When a shopper chooses Float at checkout, they split their purchase into interest-free* monthly instalments on the credit card they already have. Float takes on the risk of collecting instalments from shoppers.

You get to customise your Float offering to suit your business’s needs – how many instalments your shoppers can choose, minimum and maximum order values, and when and how you get paid for your sales processed through Float.

What are the benefits of using Float for my business?

Float is compatible with over 60 million credit cards globally, giving your business access to a large pool of potential shoppers.

Float gives your customers a flexible way to pay for higher-value purchases. The benefits of offering Float as a payment option are many, but here are just a few:

  • Access a high value, premium shopper base, who use their existing credit cards to purchase from your store
  • Increase average order values by 134%* on average.
  • Improve conversions (estimated increase of up to 20-30%) * .
  • Grow incremental sales.

What makes Float different to checkout financing options?

Float offers a flexible and straightforward way for your customers to pay with their credit card in instalments, without taking on new credit.

Unlike checkout financing options, Float does not rely on issuing new credit or loans to generate sales for merchants.
Instead, Float enables shoppers to use their existing credit to pay over flexible periods. Here are just a few reasons why this differentiates Float:
* Access a high value, premium shopper base, who use their existing credit cards.
* Compatible with 60m+ existing credit cards globally – the payment process is as straightforward as a regular card transaction.
* No limits on order sizes Float’s average order is around 10x larger* than checkout financing options
* Longer repayment periods of up to 24 months (territory dependant), interest- and fee-free from Float.*
* Customisable for your business – the number of instalments offered, minimum order values, and even the settlement terms for your sales made through Float.

*Based on Float global merchant data.
*Float splits credit card purchases into flexible monthly instalments and charges no interest or fees. The full purchase amount is authorised on the card, which reduces available credit. Instalments are collected monthly. The card issuer’s standard terms and interest will apply. Before using Float, please consider whether you can comfortably afford the repayments. Float is not authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.
